title: Union Eyes staging: remove fail-open legacy RLS policies from the deadline-engine tables
description: Mission UE-RUNTIME-REALITY-20261018 (Phase 3A). Business justification: the staging rls-verify preflight fails 1 of 1699 checks (manifest-rls deadline_reminder_executions UNENFORCED) and a runtime probe shows union_eyes_runtime with NO organization context can read, and insert into, deadline_reminders, deadline_audit_events and deadline_reminder_executions for every tenant. Cause: the PERMISSIVE PUBLIC policies installed by root migrations/0045 (deadline_reminders_tenant_isolation, deadline_audit_events_tenant_isolation, deadline_reminder_executions_read) fall back to the row's own organization when app.current_org_id is empty and are OR-ed with the 0010-style policies; the same objects exist in existing staging and in the clean-room/fresh path. Affected tables (exact scope): deadline_reminders, deadline_audit_events, deadline_reminder_executions. Desired state: RLS + FORCE + runtime and system policies and no PUBLIC policy on all three. Migration: canonical scoped migration apps/union-eyes/db/migrations-cache/0015_deadline_engine_rls_fail_closed_closure.sql (journal idx 15), executed only through the governed executor tooling/scripts/apply-union-eyes-scoped-migrations-existing-env.mjs: --check first; --apply only when the ledger shows 0000-0014 applied (otherwise stop and reconcile the ledger; do not use a bespoke apply path, do not replay the frozen db/migrations lineage). Atomic per statement set with in-transaction post-condition assertions; idempotent; no grants, roles, functions or other tables. PREREQUISITES (all required before any staging apply): (1) an application revision whose deadline worker and overdue scheduler run under withSystemContext() (main b9a54a9b or later) built through CI and serving staging by pinned digest; (2) the staging schema prerequisites in the Phase 3A dossier section 12 verified; (3) approval by service_owner and change_manager; (4) credential containment disposition from COMMAND; (5) a fresh restore point recorded and a restore clone rehearsal on the exact release candidate. Not applied to staging at the time of writing.
impact_summary: Three deadline-engine tables, one governed migration, auto-rolled back on any failed statement/assertion. Behaviour change: sessions without tenant context stop seeing or writing these tables; the system role keeps full access via TO union_eyes_system policies. Application revisions older than withSystemContext() in the deadline worker lose queue access (see prerequisites).
rollback_plan: Primary recovery is forward and secure: redeploy an application revision compatible with the fail-closed policies (deadline work under withSystemContext()); the fail-closed state is never intentionally reverted. Database restore: point-in-time restore of nzila-staging-db to a new server (rehearsed 2026-10-19, about 15 minutes) and cut over only by approved change. Exceptional only, with an explicit recorded security disposition: apps/union-eyes/db/migrations-cache/0015_deadline_engine_rls_fail_closed_closure.rollback.sql restores the legacy fail-open policies; it refuses to run unless ue.fail_open_recovery_disposition is set, reopens cross-tenant access, and the deploy-time rls-verify preflight is expected to fail until 0015 is re-applied.
